{{Quote|The leader of the camp, Attichitcuk, has been critically wounded in a Trade Federation ambush.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=AmbushofAttichitcuk.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
During a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] was '''ambushed''' by [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The leader of a group of Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] who were [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|legally authorized]] to colonize the moon, Attichitcuk had set out on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition with two [[bowcaster trooper]]s to investigate the presence of the Trade Federation, which was illegally attempting to take over Alaris Prime.

After locating several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the Wookiees headed for a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]] but encountered another group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that attacked the Wookiees after demanding their surrender. The two [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and Attichitcuk seriously injured, though the chieftain was quickly [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescued]] by his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and received medical aid.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|He says he spotted some battle droids lurking in the area.|Qui-Gon Jinn, referring to Attichitcuk|audio=SpottedBattleDroids.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] led by [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] were [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|legally authorized]] to colonize the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. The [[Alaris Prime colonists|Wookiee colonists]], led by Attichitcuk, along with his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], traveled to Alaris Prime and began [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonizing]] the moon. However, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] also sought control of the moon to use it as a trade center and illegally established a competing colony.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Gundark_nest.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An encounter at a gundark nest led to hostilities between the Wookiees and the Trade Federation.]]
On Alaris Prime, both sides faced attacks by predatory [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], prompting both the Wookiees and the Trade Federation to send their forces to the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]] to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|eliminate]] them. The Trade Federation's [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s reached the nest first and, once they had [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the gundarks, attacked Wookiee [[bowcaster trooper]]s led by Chewbacca, who fought back and destroyed all of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Following the encounter, Attichitcuk and two Wookiee [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] began a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the moon to learn more about the Trade Federation's activities.<ref name="GB" />

Meanwhile, at another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]], Chewbacca and Jinn began preparing for any future encounters with the Trade Federation by advancing to a new [[Technology level|level of technology]] and gathering various resources. Attichitcuk caught sight of several battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the area and passed on the information to Jinn. He then made his way to the base, ahead of his two companions, not realizing another group of seven Trade Federation Battle Droid Beta Versions blocked his path.<ref name="GB" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|Halt. You are ordered to come with us.|A battle droid, to Attichitcuk|audio=BattleDroidHalt.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The battle droids, commanded by [[DRN-38]], forced Attichitcuk to stop, and one droid ordered the Wookiee to come with them. The chieftain refused to comply, prompting the battle droids to fire upon Attichitcuk with [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]]. The Wookiee returned fire with his [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] but was severely wounded by the droids and left to die. Once the other Wookiees caught up to Attichitcuk, they were both shot and killed.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Attichitcuk has been shot down! But wait, I sense the spark of life in him still.|audio=HeLives.flac|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Wounded_Itchy_SWGB.png|thumb|right|260px|Attichitcuk was later rescued by his son, Chewbacca.]]
Through the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Qui-Gon Jinn sensed that Attichitcuk was still alive and urged Chewbacca to stay calm. Jinn had the Wookiees construct a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] at the base [[command center]]<ref name="GB" /> and train at least ten<ref name="GBP">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> bowcaster troopers before sending them and Chewbacca to [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] Attichitcuk. After destroying every battle droid they encountered on the path, the Wookiees reached Attichitcuk and had the [[Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] revive the chieftain. They then returned with him to the base, encountering and destroying more battle droids on the way.<ref name="GB" />

Attichitcuk was still severely injured, forcing Chewbacca to take his place as the leader of the colonists. With Jinn's guidance, the Wookiees planned and executed two [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|major]] [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|attacks]] on Trade Federation bases before driving their enemies off the moon for good with the help of a fully recovered Attichitcuk in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush of Attichitcuk was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="GBP" />&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the 2001 [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' before appearing in the game itself in its release<ref name="GB" /> on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The ambush appears in the fourth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Researching Technology,"<ref name="GB" /> as a scripted event triggered after the player researches the second technology level, a key game mechanic in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''. The player is unable to affect the outcome of the ambush.<ref name="GBP" />
